The API SLA risk calculator achieved a perfect reward score by passing all legacy pytest suites without exceptions.
The run achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.80, with 0 exceptions across all trials. Pytest version 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.58s. While the logic is stable, future iterations should re-check edge case assumptions in the weighted-risk-assessment logic to ensure the 0.80 judge reward can be improved to parity with the verifier.
